description: Returns the page where the user books a free 30-minute video call with Nikita Marushkov, the studio's founder, and the hours calls can be booked. The user picks a time on that page, or an agent that can open web pages does it for them after the user agrees to the time and contact details. The page shows times in the user's own time zone.
name: get_booking_link
title: Get Nikita's booking page
